exam_scheme.note: Recruitment examination conducted by KEA comprising a qualifying Compulsory Kannada test (for non-exempted candidates) followed by an offline competitive OMR examination comprising Paper 1 (General Knowledge) and Paper 2 (General Kannada/English and Computer Knowledge).

papers.qualifying_threshold: 35% (50 marks out of 150; exempted for candidates having passed 10th standard with Kannada as first or second language)

stages.source_label: KEA VAO Detailed Notification (Rules 9 & 12: Examination Scheme & Valuation)

papers.paper_name: Paper 2: General Kannada / General English and Computer Knowledge (Samanya Kannada / English & Computer Jnana)

financial_package.note: Salary computed as per Karnataka Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules under Karnataka State Pay Commission matrix (Scale ₹21,400–₹42,000; Entry Basic Pay ₹21,400). In-hand estimate applies mandatory project constant 58% DA as of 2025-07-01 and city-wise HRA (Bengaluru/Zone A at 27%, Class B at 18%, rural/Class C at 9%).
financial_package.pay_source_label: KEA VAO Notification (Advt. No. KEA/AD/26/RECT/2026) and Karnataka Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with Entry Basic Pay of ₹21,400 at mandatory 58% DA (₹12,412) plus HRA ranging from 9% (₹1,926) in village panchayat centers to 27% (₹5,778) in BBMP areas, less statutory NPS (10% Basic+DA), Group Insurance (KGID), and professional tax deductions.
official_perks: Karnataka Government Employees Insurance Scheme (KGID) cover
Medical reimbursement under Karnataka Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
House Rent Allowance (HRA) indexed to posting center class
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per KCSR
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with full State Government matching contribution
Earned leave accumulation and encashment benefits
